text:
rachel-partnerships: Quick thread to lock down marketplace onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure and call out the KMS consent flow required for private offers. Keep replies short - owners only please.

ben-cloud: I'll collect publisher account IDs and minimal IAM role list. For GCP we need publisher service account + roles/cloudbilling.user; AWS wants a marketplace-publish role.

harry-legal: I'll draft the data residency blurb and a short consent note for customers who provide KMS ARNs (we need explicit acceptance language). Also will check if any EU wording needs translation.

zoe-product: SKU thought: dev (free trial with rate limit), standard (token-metered), enterprise (reserved + managed SI). Add an optional "on-prem appliance" SKU for hardware partners. Trial length: 14 days for dev, 30 for standard.

omar-ops: Ops constraints: Private offer flow requires: customer KMS key ARN, cross-account key policy, and support contact for key rotation. For Azure private we need subscription consent via marketplace. Will prepare a Terraform snippet for cross-account KMS.

marketplace-bot: Validator note: uploads fail if logo < 1024px or support email missing.

rachel-partnerships: Action owners: Ben = publisher IDs & IAM doc; Harry = EULA + KMS consent copy; Zoe = final SKU json & support contact; Omar = KMS terraform + VPC notes. Target: collection complete by Thu EOD, upload sandbox Fri.

ben-cloud: I'll post publisher IDs and a short IAM snippet to the shared folder today.

harry-legal: I'll drop draft consent language by Wed morning. Quick Q: do we ever store full prompts in logs? Need to know for privacy clause.

omar-ops: No full prompts by default; only aggregated telemetry. We keep a debug-mode that customers opt into for support where we may temporarily capture more. I'll include that in the ops playbook.

zoe-product: Adding "on-prem appliance" SKU to the draft so hardware partners can list co-branded offers. Also adding SI add-on as per-seat monthly SKU.

rachel-partnerships: Great. Quick sync Fri 9am PT to walk the manifest before sandbox upload. If any hardware/SI leads want to join, reply and I'll loop them in.

ben-cloud: Copy.

harry-legal: I'll be there.

omar-ops: Will add terraform snippet and sample key policy to the drive.

marketplace-bot: Post-upload: run will surface schema issues here. Tag #manifest-fails for follow-ups.

rachel-partnerships: Thanks team — short and actionable. I'll send invite and checklist.
